verdict.rationale: Latham's IP Litigation page lists Trade Secrets Litigation as an area of focus. It describes its team of more than 100 IP litigators as handling trade secrets cases, and a quoted Chambers USA 2026 ranking specifically credits the firm with trade secret disputes. Missing for 10: no evidence of confidentiality-program or trade-secret protection counseling, no explicit employee-mobility dispute work (the employment page is generic), and no specific trade-secret matters or case examples.
